prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1108; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end impact sustained while turning left at low speed. Presenting complaints were neck and back strain with paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the symptom pattern fits the forces described. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. Patient reports no prior injury to these body areas, and none is documented in available records. Care proceeded along a typical conservative course, including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction, over 27 visits. Symptoms and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed toward discharge. Two charges for similar services on the same date of service are currently under billing review to confirm they are not duplicates. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise. Patient may return as needed for flare-ups.
